modules.description: Modules this user can open: enabled for the company, not locked for their branch or for them.

module_tiles.description: Dashboard tiles: every module available to the user's company and branch. state: open | locked (locked for this user) | no_permission. `parent`: the module this one is opened from (e.g. leave inside hr); such modules have no dashboard tile.

roles.description: Assigned roles plus roles handed over to the user right now.

permissions.description: Effective permission names, e.g. "leave.approve-hr". The UI shows actions from this list only.

acting_roles.description: Roles the user holds temporarily for someone else (handover).

is_head.description: Heads (or deputies) of a department or section: they start on "My department".

idle_minutes.description: Minutes without activity before the app logs out (the server ends the session too).

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons name without the "bi-" prefix.

is_core.description: Core modules are always available to every company.

slug.description: Key used by the frontend module manifest, e.g. "leave".

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons name without the "bi-" prefix, e.g. "person-circle".

is_default.description: Used when no format is chosen (registration, contract types without a format).

value.description: `text`: the text. `department`: code used when the department has no short name.

next_number.description: The number the next employee would get.

kind.description: accounts, creditors, debtors or breakdowns. Ignored when updating.

date.description: The go-live date, within the first fiscal year.

file.description: CSV in the template layout of the batch kind.

rows.description: Each row is checked on its own; good rows are kept and the result of every row is returned. Give ids or codes/names.

supplier.description: Supplier name; created when not found by TIN or name.

party.description: Breakdowns: client or other party the amount belongs to.

months.description: Number of months; empty: until stopped.

end_time.description: An end before the start runs past midnight.

department_id.description: Department, or a section (its department is found).

unit.description: hour (paid by the minutes) or shift (one shift per claim).

period.description: Months. End date = start + period - 1 day.

retention_account_id.description: Liability holding retention money until it is released.

damages_account_id.description: Income (or cost recovery) account for liquidated damages deducted from suppliers.

advance_account_id.description: Asset account for advances paid to suppliers, recovered from later certificates.

variation_limit_percent.description: Total price increases allowed by variations, as a percentage of the contract value.

type.description: yearly: same day every year; once: on one date.

certificate.description: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.

approval_status.description: approved, pending (added by the employee, waiting for HR) or rejected

kind.description: invoice (pays invoices of a customer) or direct (no invoice: cash sale, donation, other income).

method.description: cash, bank, mobile, cheque or card.

slug.description: Login link name (/login?org=...). Generated from the short name or name when empty.

phone.description: Phone, email and address are printed in the header of the company's documents.

fiscal_year_start.description: Month and day the fiscal year starts, e.g. "07-01".

branches.description: At least one branch. The one marked is_headquarters (or the first) is the head office.

modules.description: Modules the company may use. Core modules are always available.

admin.description: The company's first HR admin. Gets an employee record, a user account and an invite email.

source.description: `hr` (started by HR) or `employee` (requested by the employee).

agreement.description: The statement the employee agreed to, and when.

basic_salary.description: Hidden from the employee while approvers are changing it; shown once final.

waiting_for.description: The approval step it is waiting for.

workflow_id.description: Approval request, for its page in Approvals.

kind.description: normal or special (emergency / outside the plan, needs a reason).

keep_department.description: True when an employee hands it back but the department keeps it.

is_locked.description: company-admin: always every permission, cannot be edited or deleted.

code.description: Short code shown on the roster grid, e.g. M.

is_working.description: The employee is expected at work (off, leave and rest codes are not).

break_minutes.description: Break in minutes, taken off the hours.

duties.description: Changed days. A null roster_code_id clears the day.

overtime.description: Overtime is planned on this day. Left out: kept as it is.

max_overtime_hours.description: Most overtime hours that may be claimed for this duty (with overtime on).

reason.description: Why the published roster changes (sent with a change request).

department_id.description: Department, or a section (its department is found).

title.description: Left empty: the department or section and the period, e.g. "Ward A · December 2026".

repeat_from_id.description: Fill the new roster by repeating the duties of this roster.

reason.description: promotion, demotion, performance, market, cost_of_living, correction or other.

effective_date.description: From this date the contract gets the new salary (default today; a future date is applied on that day).

content.description: Paragraphs separated by an empty line.

image.description: Optional photo shown as the login background with this announcement (max 4 MB).

company_branch_id.description: Empty = the company-wide workflow; a branch id = that branch's own workflow (overrides the company one).

steps.description: Approval steps in order. An empty list removes the workflow (changes then apply at once).

approver_type.description: role = anyone with the role; user = one person; department_head = head of the requester's department; section_head = head of the employee's section (department head when there is none); supervisor = the employee's supervisor.

same_branch.description: Role approvers: only people from the request's branch.

min_amount.description: Step applies only when the request's amount is at least this (processes with an amount). Empty = always.

purpose.description: "invite" (default, link valid 3 days) or "reset" (forgot password, link valid 60 minutes).

permissions.description: Permissions given directly to the user, on top of their roles. Prefer roles.

roles.description: The full list of the user's roles (names). A user can have several.

reason.description: Why the access changed (kept in the history; will be shown to approvers).

message.description: Placeholders: {first_name}, {name}, {employee_no}. SMS is cut at the gateway limit.

recipient_type.description: individual, department, section, branch or all

popup.description: In-app notices only: also show as a pop-up to the recipients between popup_from and popup_until (one pop-up at a time).

reason.description: receipts: opening, donation, found or return.

email.description: Required when `create_account` is true: the invite is sent here.

department_id.description: Company-wide or of the employee's branch.

section_id.description: A section of the chosen department.

job_position_id.description: A position of the chosen department (or one not tied to a department).

create_account.description: Also create a user account (role "employee") and email an invite to set the password.

from_user_id.description: The person handing over (optional, for the record).

special_group.description: women, youth, disability, elderly or local.

logo.description: PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG, max 1 MB. Shown in the top bar, login page and documents.

login_background.description: Login page photo. JPG, PNG or WEBP, max 4 MB, landscape works best (1920×1080).

primary_color.description: Main color (buttons, links, active menu), e.g. "#0d6efd". Empty = default.

secondary_color.description: Top bar color. Empty = same as primary.

theme_sidebar.description: Sidebar style: plain, tinted or solid (top bar color).

theme_navbar.description: Top bar style: plain, tinted or solid (top bar color).

theme_tables.description: Table headings: plain, tinted or solid (top bar color).

theme_cards.description: Cards: plain, accent (main color stripe on top) or tinted (header).

theme_tiles.description: Home page module tiles: brand (company colors) or module (each module's own color).

modules.description: The full list of enabled modules. Modules not listed are disabled.

phone.description: Phone, email and address are printed in the header of the company's documents, so they cannot be cleared.

is_active.description: false = suspended: the company's users can no longer log in.

email.description: Required when `create_account` is true: the invite is sent here.

department_id.description: Company-wide or of the employee's branch.

section_id.description: A section of the chosen department.

job_position_id.description: A position of the chosen department (or one not tied to a department).

days.description: Working days; days left out are off. day: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. An end before the start runs past midnight.

department_ids.description: Departments or sections that use these hours.

comment.description: Required when rejecting or sending back.

to_step.description: Send back only: the step order to return to.

subject_id.description: Id of the record the request is about (e.g. the contract renewal).

link.description: Where to see the record in the app.

can_act.description: The current user can approve / reject / send back now.

can_cancel.description: The current user (the requester) can withdraw it.

send_back_options.description: Earlier steps this request can be sent back to. @var list<array{step_order: int, name: string}>

steps.description: Timeline. @var list<array{step_order: int, name: string, approver: string, status: string, acted_by: string|null, acted_at: string|null, comment: string|null}>

retained_earnings_account_id.description: Equity account that receives each year's result (retained earnings or accumulated fund).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
